description:
An Empire in the Clouds by Ai Jiang is an unusual blend of fantasy and science fiction, heavily inspired by Chinese culture and, in particular, Chinese opera. The story is set in the two empires of Piao and Opera and primarily follows Xilian and No Face in different POV as they face political intrigue, oppression […]
